task.prompt:
Implement a PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL stored procedure that performs the data changes shown in the attached set of worked examples.The procedure operates only on the tables whose starting states are shown in those examples.

The exact procedure signature is:
sp(para_height integer, para_birthday text, para_player_api_id integer, para_id integer, para_team_short_name text, para_team_fifa_api_id integer)

Return the complete stored procedure source and nothing else.
